tools.name: hip_get_service_info
tools.description: What Have It Printed does and what it costs: the products, prices, accepted file types and sizes, and how each is mailed. Call it when you need prices or limits; it needs no job and changes nothing. Returns a short summary and the same facts as structured fields. Needs a Bearer API key, like every t

tools.name: hip_create_job
tools.description: Start one print-and-mail job: one order of documents, or one letter or postcard written here. Call it first: every other job tool takes the job_handle it returns. Creates nothing chargeable. Returns job_handle, state and expires_at (an unpaid job expires).

tools.name: hip_get_upload_target
tools.description: Get a short-lived upload URL for a file the person already has (a PDF, Word file or image). Use this for an existing file; use hip_add_text_document for text you wrote with the person, or hip_set_letter for a letter in a handwriting-style font. Needs a job_handle from hip_create_job. Returns upload_

Needs a job_handle from hip_create_job. Add a letter or document whose text you wrote with the person. Have It

tools.name: hip_set_letter

Use it after hip

tools.name: hip_create_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for the job so the person pays on haveitprinted.com. This does NOT take payment: the person completes payment at checkout_url. Call it after hip_quote (show them the quote first); to pay with no person, use hip_prepare_payment and hip_complete_payment (when listed) inst

tools.name: hip_get_checkout_status
tools.description: Whether the person has paid at the checkout link yet. Use it after hip_create_checkout, while waiting for payment; once paid is true, use hip_get_order for printing, shipping and tracking. Payment truth comes from the order record Stripe's webhook creates, never from a browser redirect. Returns paid

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target · Private data: hip_get_service_info, hip_create_job, hip_get_upload_target, hip_add_text_document, hip_set_postcard, hip_set_letter, hip_update_job, hip_quote, hip_get_checkout_status, hip_prepare_payment, hip_complete_payment · Public sink: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target, hip_get_checkout_status, hip_complete_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target · Private data: hip_get_service_info, hip_create_job, hip_get_upload_target, hip_add_text_document, hip_set_postcard, hip_set_letter, hip_update_job, hip_quote, hip_get_checkout_status, hip_prepare_payment, hip_complete_payment · Public sink: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target, hip_get_checkout_status, hip_complete_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
